answer: Trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, using degree-normalized transitions. A sybil coalition gains weight only through credible ingress; if its induced cluster has a sparse boundary, low conductance bounds walk escape probability. Min-cut transitivity therefore caps aggregate voting weight, while honest connectivity dilutes internally amplified support. An atlas may show a vine crossing regions, but only edges permit passage; saffron labels add no conductance.
